completion_rule: Every required case needs retained actual passing evidence. Missing, mock-only, unrelated-error, skipped or not-run required acceptance is incomplete, not a pass.

cases.criterion: One source-supported document finding before signup; insufficient evidence stays explicit.
Ordinary maintenance exports produce the fixed finding; guided mappings persist across revisions.
Supplied markup/return preparation reaches the fixed receiving finding; no unrun reading claim.
Equal bare tags across units never merge; ambiguous bare selection refuses specifically.
Explicit alias/tag crosswalk and physical replacement preserve distinct identities/history.
Boolean/number/null/lexical values and units survive; incompatible/unknown units do not silently merge.
Both conflicting sourced values and applicability survive order reversal and receiving.
Missing, withdrawn, superseded, unavailable and hash-mismatched sources remain distinct.
Fresh-process discovery, lookup, typed traversal and evidence retrieval produce fixed sourced answers/gaps.
List, datasheet and loop/narrative outline reuse the same facts with per-field basis and per-target gaps.
A bounded common-basis projection is actually consumed by an existing generator contract without invented engineering facts.
Network membership is not adjacency; signal/association is not physical flow or control strategy.
Three revisions retain history and identify fixed dependent fields while proven independent content remains unaffected.
Revision-only/source withdrawal changes do not silently inherit current review; declare actual refresh policy.
A manual edit survives or is explicitly reported after reopen and regeneration; unrelated fields remain exact.
Generated/copied document reimport cannot increase independent support for its source claims.
Selected scope and explicit boundary references survive complete typed readback; navigation is not filtering.
Relocated fresh-process readback/export works without original workspace; required originals and archive-only fields remain accounted for.
Inspect actual ChangePilot version/contracts; implement and test missing bounded receiver through canonical surfaces.
Normal app authorization enforces owner/tenant scope and access withdrawal; no service-role-only proof or implicit share.
Real persisted UI/agent readback reproduces fixed facts, citations, unknowns, conflicts and history.
Repeated delivery does not duplicate or overwrite unrelated existing records.
Interrupted delivery has explicit recoverable/atomic outcome; no silent half-current scope.
Stale/divergent base is specifically refused or explicitly reconciled without losing either history.
Subsequent product source/conflict/withdrawal revision retains history and correct dependency status.
Complete declared scope exports from ChangePilot and reopens with types, lineage, conflicts/history and omissions accounted for.
Recorded matched customer journey: fixed useful result; zero JSON editing, repeated fact entry or repeated admitted-dialect mapping; count genuine clarification/setup/retry work.
Desktop and 390px actual interactions show sources, conflicts, drafts/revisions and product receiving without dead ends or hidden omissions.
Measure time/memory/size at 100/1000/10000 synthetic assets, plus explicit over-limit refusal; report admitted limits and failures.
Predeclared public/second-dialect transfer runs on frozen tools/checker; provenance/exposure and failures remain visible.
Clean-clone offline replay, independent checking/product Judge, affected regressions/registries/full CI/governed landing and accurate docs pass with skips declared.

human_company_trials: Separately unrun; software simulation cannot establish engineer benefit, plant truth or customer acceptance.
